module_summary: Virtual-FIFO read engine: issues AXI read bursts from a DRAM ring buffer based on write-finish pointer, buffers returned data in per-segment dual-clock FIFOs with gray-code pointer sync, and streams segments out on output_clk.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read-address valid, raised when a full or timed-out burst is issued

anchors.name: m_axi_arready
anchors.why: AXI read-address ready clears pending arvalid

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Burst address = base addr + masked read start pointer

anchors.name: m_axi_arlen
anchors.why: Burst length from computed rd_burst_len minus one

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data written into per-segment FIFO memories

anchors.name: m_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid; with rready advances FIFO write pointer and finish pointer

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: Read data ready when internal FIFO not full or cfg reset

anchors.name: output_data
anchors.why: Segmented output data from per-segment read data registers

anchors.name: output_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment output valid from seg_rd_data_valid_reg

anchors.name: output_ready
anchors.why: Per-segment downstream ready gating FIFO reads

anchors.name: read_fifo_seg[*].seg_mem_data
anchors.why: Per-segment dual-clock FIFO RAM buffering AXI read data

anchors.name: read_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: FIFO write pointer, increments on accepted AXI read beat, addresses RAM

anchors.name: read_fifo_seg[*].seg_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Per-segment read pointer on output_clk, addresses RAM read

anchors.name: read_fifo_wr_ptr_gray_sync_2_reg
anchors.why: Gray write pointer synchronized into output_clk for empty detection

anchors.name: read_fifo_rd_ptr_sync_reg
anchors.why: Binary read pointer synchronized back to clk for occupancy

anchors.name: read_fifo_full
anchors.why: FIFO full blocks rready and FIFO writes

anchors.name: read_fifo_seg[*].seg_empty
anchors.why: Segment empty flag blocks reads from segment RAM

anchors.name: read_fifo_occupancy_lookahead_reg
anchors.why: Occupancy incl. outstanding bursts; gates new burst issue when space lacking

anchors.name: rd_start_ptr_reg
anchors.why: DRAM ring read start pointer, drives burst address and length

anchors.name: rd_finish_ptr_reg
anchors.why: DRAM read finish pointer advanced per completed read beat

anchors.name: wr_finish_ptr_in
anchors.why: Writer finish pointer; compared to rd_start_ptr to decide burst length

anchors.name: rd_outstanding_reg
anchors.why: Outstanding read beats counter, drives sts_read_active

anchors.name: rd_timeout_count_reg
anchors.why: Partial-burst timeout down-counter

anchors.name: rd_timeout_reg
anchors.why: Timeout flag allowing a partial burst to issue

anchors.name: rd_burst_len
anchors.why: Computed burst length bounded by burst boundary or available data

anchors.name: read_fifo_read_start_en
anchors.why: Burst issue enable; reserves FIFO space via read start pointer

anchors.name: cfg_enable
anchors.why: Enables issuing new AXI read bursts

anchors.name: cfg_fifo_base_addr
anchors.why: Base address of DRAM FIFO region added to read pointer

anchors.name: sts_read_active
anchors.why: Status: reads outstanding

anchors.name: genblk2.read_fifo_ctrl_seg[*].seg_mem_data
anchors.why: Control-output FIFO RAM, disabled when CTRL_OUT_EN=0

anchors.name: genblk2.read_fifo_ctrl_seg[*].seg_output_data_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer output register for ctrl output, parameter-disabled

groups.name: AXI read burst generator
groups.description: Computes burst length/address from DRAM pointers, issues AR bursts, tracks outstanding reads and timeout

groups.name: Read data FIFO
groups.description: Per-segment dual-clock FIFOs with gray pointer synchronization buffering AXI read data

groups.name: Segment output
groups.description: Streams per-segment FIFO read data out on output_clk with valid/ready

groups.name: Control output path
groups.description: Optional ctrl FIFO plus skid buffer, disabled by CTRL_OUT_EN=0

groups.name: Output reset synchronizer
groups.description: Synchronizes cfg_reset into output_clk domain producing output_rst_out
